reason: The trigger is real: a $300M Series B led by Radical Ventures with NVIDIA participating at a reported ~$4B valuation, announced 18-19 May 2026, with DOS 2.0 launched alongside it (The Next Web, CTech; the decart.ai release was egress-blocked and is confirmed only through those summaries). The signal has since been overtaken: Bloomberg / Fortune reported on 13 Aug 2026 that Anthropic is in talks to buy Decart for about $6B, and CTech reported later in August that the two sides are exchanging advanced drafts at roughly $7B, paid mostly in Anthropic stock, with Decart having walked away from a higher NVIDIA offer; no signing had been reported as of 6 Sep 2026. Anthropic's Claude is already on the grid as Atlassian Williams Racing's Official Thinking Partner (multi-year, 2026), so the budget owner after signing would be an existing F1 partner, and an independent Decart sponsorship pitch has no counterparty with authority to commit to a three-year deal while the sale is being papered. Screened rather than built: re-open only if the Anthropic deal collapses. Also corrected from the thin row: the 'NVIDIA and Amazon AWS Trainium partnerships' are an NVIDIA investment in the round and a Trainium3 deployment of the Lucy2 model, not announced strategic partnerships; the earlier 5 May duplicate row with the same source URL should be dropped.
